name: rewatchable-streams
description: a bot that regularly re-generates a webpage that maps The Rewatchables podcast episodes to streaming services where the movies can be watched.
author: greg tracy

scripts.install:all: for d in packages/fetch_url packages/rss_polling packages/streams_fetch packages/streams_refresh packages/www_job packages/landing-page bin utils; do echo "==> Installing $d" && (cd "$d" && npm install) || exit 1; done
scripts.test:backend: for d in packages/fetch_url packages/rss_polling packages/streams_fetch packages/streams_refresh packages/www_job bin utils; do echo "==> Testing $d" && (cd "$d" && npm test) || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run test:fixtures && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
